description: Full details for one CielStay listing: description, photos, amenities, house rules, location, and every booking link CielStay holds, including the host's own booking site; hostTrust says what CielStay checked about the host and carries the host's own statements (how they take bookings, payment, cancellation). With checkIn and checkOut, the response also carries liveQuote where the host's booking engine supports it: the total on the host's own site for those dates (room, fees and taxes), read live. Each live quote is a real request to the host's booking engine. Accepts the listing id, the slug from a listing URL, or a short code (the "1zwf" in cielstay.com/l/1zwf).

checkIn.description: Arrival date, YYYY-MM-DD. With checkOut, returns the live total from the host's own booking site.

guests.description: Number of guests, for the live quote. Defaults to 2.

id.description: The listing ID from a previous search result (result.id).

name: get_listing_details

bookNow.description: Present when the host offers Book now (book_stay): the host's limits for it

maxNights.description: Longest stay the host accepts through Book now

minLeadDays.description: Fewest days between booking and arrival

alsoListedOn.description: Other platforms this home is listed on

source.description: 'checked' when CielStay matched the link, or the home is claimed; 'host' when the host added it and CielStay has not checked it

bookingSite.description: The host's booking-site domain and the year it was registered, from public domain records

hostWords.description: The host's own policy, or their notes alongside the standard one

summary.description: The standard CielStay policy the host chose, in one sentence (refund by days before check-in)

preset.description: null when the host wrote their own policy

cancellation.description: The cancellation policy the host set; refunds come from the host, not CielStay

fromHost.description: Statements in the host's own words: not checked by CielStay

onCielStaySince.description: YYYY-MM: when the home was added to CielStay, not how long the host has hosted

verified.description: verified_owner, verified_in_person or verified_via_listing; null when CielStay has not verified the host

hostTrust.description: What CielStay checked about the host, and statements in the host's own words (fromHost; not checked by CielStay)

liveQuote.description: The total on the host's own site for the dates asked, read live; null when it couldn't be read

basis.description: What the figure is: e.g. avg_night_incl_fees, avg_nightly_rate_excl_fees, host_set, monthly_rent

label.description: The qualifier to show next to the price

title: Get listing details
